description_zh: GPK 目标、项目与知识管理方法论及工作流路由。
description_en: GPK goal, project, and knowledge workflows and routing.

gpk.description_zh: 解释 GPK 目标、项目与知识方法，路由 Setup、Plan、Work、Ingest 与 Review 工作流。
gpk.description_en: Explain the GPK method and route Setup, Plan, Work, Ingest, and Review workflows.

gpk-setup.description_zh: 检查 GPK 就绪状态，打开浏览器配置知识库连接、工作区结构与授权权限。
gpk-setup.description_en: Check GPK readiness and open the browser console to connect a workspace and grant permissions.

gpk-plan.description_zh: 将目标拆解为关联领域的项目（Objective、KR 与首批任务），维护领域方向。
gpk-plan.description_en: Frame goals into Area-linked Projects with Objectives, KRs, and initial Tasks.

gpk-work.description_zh: 聚焦下一步可执行行动，推进任务状态、记录项目材料与每日活动。
gpk-work.description_en: Pick the next executable action, advance Task state, and record Project progress.

gpk-ingest.description_zh: 按捕获、研读或深研深度沉淀外部资料、导入笔记与开发会话记录。
gpk-ingest.description_en: Capture, study, or research external sources, imported notes, and coding sessions.

gpk-review.description_zh: 执行日/周/月复盘，对齐收件箱、逾期任务、在途项目信号与领域状态。
gpk-review.description_en: Run daily, weekly, or monthly reviews across captures, Tasks, Projects, and Areas.
